definitions: The action of speaking or acting on behalf of someone or of being so represented.
The description or portrayal of someone or something in a particular way.
A thing that represents something else, especially a symbol, sign, or work of art.
A formal protest or statement of facts.
examples: The trade union provides representation for its members.
The artist's representation of the landscape was stunning.
The map is a representation of the city.
There is a lack of female representation in parliament.
They made strong representations to the committee.
